method.name: multiformat_bounded_serial_anchors_v1
method.assumptions: Conditional on all 200 base subjects substantially reaching non-encased packs at the selected Blue /75, Gold /50, Orange /25, Pink /15, Primaries /10 and Red /5 serial ceilings. Each anchor may deviate by 3%. Model bounds are sensitivity ranges, not confidence intervals. Encased and non-encased odds columns remain independent; no encased production estimate is published. No one-of-one or autograph calibration.
